selection: First exactly matching supplied-pose consecutive even/odd pair in each of six named sessions; source split already locked TRAINlab/VALhall. Full-catalog pair identification uses metadata/hash only; pixel/depth diagnostics initially restricted to these six pairs.
pair_identity: Same session and identical supplied4x4pose bytes and sameK; exactly2 fully joined frames with consecutive even then odd ids. Paper documents one unoccluded and one cardboard-occluded capture per position, but frame ordering is checked visually and by depth rather than inferred from mask0.
transforms: Use supplied poses and K only. No PnP, ICP, optimization, learned flow or fitted alignment. Object-in-camera direction follows explicit README p_cam=T@p_obj; direct versus inverse overlay comparison is diagnostic, never pose refinement.
before_positive_core: Before SAM-named mask eroded radius2 (native5x5 all-positive) AND both measured depths positive. Mask source is human-prompted SAM, not independent human pixel truth.
foreground_candidate: Db-Da>=50mm at the same native pixel for identical T/K. Do not require after mask0 and do not turn mask0 into E/O. Candidate remains dependent on camera stability and before-positive provenance.
stable_visible_candidate: Before positive core, both depths valid, afterSAMpositive and |Da-Db|<=20mm.
ambiguous: Every other point U. No true OUTSIDE or semantic SELF labels are derived.
strict_mesh_evidence: Separately flag before-positive points where supplied-pose mesh-render depth exists and |Dmesh-Db|<=max(20mm,1%Db). Do not blindly treat all depth-positive points as target agreement.
sensitivity_only: Also count foreground margins100mm and200mm. They are descriptive, not thresholds selected from current data or performance.
stability_diagnostics: Provided-pose/K identity reprojection, unchanged common-positive target RGB differences and measured after-before depth residual distributions; retain uncertainty if not aligned. No new alignment transformation is estimated.
admission: Family independence follows user's direct factual confirmation via root metadata, license officialCCBY4; exactRGBSHAdenylist still required. Label/registration/geometry quality gates remain separate before any fit.
scope: Source-only, no current/private RGB or GT/scores, no model inference, no GPU, no training/threshold tuning/PnP. All v63-v65 artifacts unchanged.
